title: Cartilage Intermediate Layer Protein-1 Promotes Extracellular Matrix Degeneration via Interacting With CD47.
authors: Deng, Jiezhong; Yang, Yusheng; Xiang, Yu; Luo, Fei; Xu, Jianzhong; Zhang, Zehua; He, Jinyue
journal: Journal of cellular and molecular medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CILP-1蛋白与CD47受体互作促进椎间盘退变，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA体系，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Intervertebral Disc Degeneration (IDD) is a multifactorial result contributing to Low Back Pain (LBP) while Cartilage Intermediate Layer Protein-1 (CILP-1) is gradually up-regulated along with IDD. Whether CILP-1 acts in a direct role promoting IDD via regulating matrix metabolism remains to be elucidated. Herein, we firstly detected the expression level of matrix-related phenotypes in nucleus pulposus (NP) cells treated with CILP-1, including ADAMTS, MMPs, IL-6, Collagens, Aggrecan (ACAN) and SOX9. Meanwhile, the phosphorylation levels of MAPKs and NF-kappaB were detected to explore the involved signalling pathways, which were further validated by inhibition experiments. Furthermore, molecular docking analysis was employed to evaluate the possibility of CD47 acting as the direct receptor mediating CILP's regulation above, which was further validated by immunoprecipitation and inhibition experiment. Our findings have made a comprehensive investigation into the regulatory effect of CILP-1 on the matrix metabolism of NP cells and explored the underlying mechanism.
abstract_zh: 椎间盘退变（IDD）是多因素导致的结果，与下背痛（LBP）相关，而软骨中间层蛋白-1（CILP-1）随着IDD的发展逐渐上调。CILP-1是否通过调节基质代谢直接促进IDD的作用尚待阐明。在此，我们首先检测了经CILP-1处理的髓核（NP）细胞中基质相关表型的表达水平，包括ADAMTS、MMPs、IL-6、胶原蛋白、聚集蛋白聚糖（ACAN）和SOX9。同时，检测了MAPKs和NF-kappaB的磷酸化水平，以探索涉及的信号通路，并通过抑制实验进一步验证。此外，采用分子对接分析评估CD47作为直接受体介导上述CILP调节的可能性，并通过免疫沉淀和抑制实验进一步验证。我们的研究对CILP-1对NP细胞基质代谢的调节作用进行了全面探讨，并探索了其潜在机制。
